thread.title: QQQ, GDG: Big ETF Inflows

author: BNK Invest
title: QQQ, GDG: Big ETF Inflows
text:
Shutterstock photo Comparing units outstanding versus one week ago at the coverage universe of ETFs at ETF Channel, the biggest inflow was seen in the Invesco QQQ ( QQQ ), which added 12,750,000 units, or a 3.3% increase week over week. Among the largest underlying components of QQQ, in morning trading today Microsoft ( MSFT ) is down about 3.2%, and Apple ( AAPL ) is lower by about 3.1%.
And on a percentage change basis, the ETF with the biggest increase in inflows was the GDG ETF ( GDG ), which added 125,000 units, for a 35.7% increase in outstanding units.
